_sources.brand: From their own website: dark navy header/footer (#1a222c) and yellow buttons (#f2b52c). primary = yellow #f2b52c with primaryInk #0b1626 (9.9:1), dark = navy #1a222c (white 16.0:1), accent = yellow (8.7:1 on dark). Concept mark (three wiregrass blades) is original.
_sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session: 3 complete 5-star reviews copied verbatim covering different jobs (Lloyd Townsell: covered patio, Christopher Hooper: fireplace surround, Jennifer Walworth: odd jobs list). Note: one 1-star review (Shannon Thomas) says a visit time was never confirmed.

gap: Call-or-text only: the Canva site's only way to ask for an estimate is calling or texting, with no form or booking, and a recent 1-star review says a visit time was never confirmed. A request form with instant confirmation and a booking calendar would close that loop.

realReviews.author: Lloyd Townsell
realReviews.text: I had Wiregrass Handyman build a covered patio for relaxing by my pool and  just enjoying our back yard rain or shine. Michael and his crew showed up when he promised on time and completed the project in a very professional and timely manner. Michael surprised me with his attention to details when it came to making sure everything was built without taking short cuts or cutting corners. After the project was completed,  Michael made sure I was satisfied before he put any of his tools up. I couldn't be more pleased, and would recommend him and will definitely call him for any future projects or repairs that I may need.

realReviews.author: Christopher Hooper
realReviews.text:
Can’t say enough good things! Michael is the best. We had him build a fireplace surround for us while we were gone on vacation. He is very detail oriented and did exactly what we wanted. And he also cleaned everything up when he was finished. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!
Thank you Michael

realReviews.author: Jennifer Walworth
realReviews.text: I am so very pleased with the work done at my house!!! I contacted Wiregrass Handyman at the last minute and luckily he was able to fit me into his schedule. He completed several small odd jobs that I’d been putting off for a while…hanging pictures, installing curtain rods, replacing 3 pendant lights, and mounting a new toilet paper holder! If you’ve been putting off your to-do list, give Wiregrass Handyman a call. Michael will take good care of you!
